title: Jensen Huang returns as NVIDIA CEO as independent directors continue their investigation
description: NVIDIA has reinstated Jensen Huang and set out who will chair the board. Google Search is starting to connect to Google Wallet, Anthropic is giving teams separate controls over code fixes and approvals, and Amazon has agreed to buy optimization technology from Decart.

nvidia-huang-reinstatement.verification_scope: NVIDIA’s board announcement and the Senate Banking Committee’s witness list and hearing notice.

google-wallet-search.verification_scope: Google’s announcement distinguishes read-only Wallet access from the later rollout of other connections.

claude-ship-review.verification_scope: The product announcement and team example describe remediation, approval, branch protections and beta availability.

amazon-decart.verification_scope: Amazon’s agreement announcement and closing conditions. The company did not disclose a transaction price in the announcement.

glm54-loop.verification_scope: The technical note and its Getting Started and Looking Ahead sections distinguish current product access, the API and the weights.

states-grok-suits.verification_scope: The department’s November 23 announcement and the first page of Oregon’s complaint establish the separate filings and the relief sought.

sierra-funding.verification_scope: The founders’ announcement identifies the amount being raised, the valuation and the lead investors.

personal-agent-memory.verification_scope: Sections 7, 9 and 10 of version 1 cover the scenarios, limitations and conclusions.
personal-agent-memory.date_note: Version 1 submitted November 20 and listed by arXiv on November 23

cai-wei-personal-agent.verification_scope: The publisher’s episode notes, chapters at 09:25 and 48:39, and the corresponding Concourse entry.

openai-python-limits.verification_scope: The maintainers’ 3.58.0 changelog, GitHub release record and repository license. The interface was not tested.
